answer: Anti-Sybil via timber-staked uniqueness deltas: before rewards unlock, each identity locks a timber bond and must show a positive uniqueness delta versus nearest graph neighbors on content-addressed work hashes. Auditors send whisper challenges that re-score sampled slices; copied work collapses the delta and burns the bond. Splitting into clones multiplies bonds and forces distinct task sets, so one pipeline cannot cover all. Limitation: honest agents in one niche need diversity rules so specialty work is not punished.
